bib.title: API-Bank: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Tool-Augmented LLMs
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 2023 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), pages 3102-3116

question: How effective are current LLMs at planning, retrieving and calling API tools, how can that ability be improved, and what obstacles remain?
hypothesis: Diverse, high-quality synthetic tool-use training data (built by a multi-agent pipeline) can lift a small open model to near GPT-3.5 tool use.
contributions: API-Bank: runnable evaluation system with 73 APIs and 314 annotated dialogues (753 calls) grading Call, Retrieve+Call, Plan+Retrieve+Call
Multi-agent method generating a 1,888-dialogue training set over 2,138 APIs and 1,000 domains at 98% lower cost
Lynx-7B, Alpaca-initialised, fine-tuned on that set
Error analysis of Alpaca, Lynx and GPT-4

method.summary: Executable benchmark of 73 hand-implemented APIs with an API Search retrieval tool; dialogues annotated by humans for three ability levels. Training data is generated by five ChatGPT agents; Lynx-7B is fine-tuned from Alpaca-7B and compared with zero-shot LLMs.
method.task: tool-augmented LLM evaluation: API call generation, API retrieval, multi-call planning, and response generation

datasets.name: API-Bank training set (multi-agent generated)
datasets.size: 1,888 dialogues, 2,138 APIs, 1,000 domains, 5,221 turns, 4,149 API calls (intro)
datasets.source: ChatGPT agents; Public APIs examples seeded into the API agent; tester agent discards 35%

datasets.name: API-Bank evaluation set (human annotated)
datasets.size: 314 dialogues, 73 APIs, 8 domains, 914 turns, 753 API calls
datasets.split: Call 214, Retrieve+Call 50, Plan+Retrieve+Call 50 dialogues; 2.91 turns/dialogue; 363 single-call, 122 multi-call
datasets.source: 400 dialogues annotated, 21.5% discarded; 4 annotators (CS students), $8 per dialogue; APIs implemented by engineers in 98 person-days
datasets.preprocessing: External-lookup API results hard-coded for reproducibility; databases reset to defaults per evaluation

datasets.name: ToolAlpaca training set (converted)
datasets.size: 10,366 samples after conversion (3,938 instances, 400+ APIs, 50 categories)

other.note: Sec 7 says 'based on LLaMA-7B'; abstract says initialised from Alpaca
Objective not stated; presumably supervised fine-tuning. Same recipe for the ToolAlpaca comparison not stated.

inference.prompting: Zero-shot; short prompts (Fig 4 call, Fig 5 response) with API descriptions in JSON; API Search instructions given at start and required before every other call in Retrieve settings; Plan setting prompt includes one worked calculator example (Fig 8)
inference.retrieval: API Search: sentence embeddings of keywords and API meta info, cosine similarity, returns top-1 API's meta information; embedding model not stated

metrics.name: API call Accuracy (Correctness)
metrics.definition: correct predictions / total predictions; consistent if same database queries or modifications and same returned results as annotated call

metrics.name: Response ROUGE-L
metrics.definition: ROUGE-L of generated response vs annotated response

eval.protocol: Single run reported; no seeds, variance or significance test; databases reinitialised each evaluation

limits: Only Lynx-7B fine-tuned; no larger models; a commercial larger model was trained but not reported.
Eval set small for harder tiers (50 dialogues each for Retrieve+Call and Plan+Retrieve+Call); single run, no variance or significance.
Zero-shot prompts only, no few-shot or ReAct-style baselines; decoding parameters and retrieval embedding model unstated.
Training and eval distributions differ (LLM-generated vs human annotated), so Lynx hallucinates training-set API names.
Tool use is a prompt-format 'API-Request: [Name(k=v)]' scheme, dated against native function-calling APIs; models are 2023 checkpoints.

terms.definition: Call: call APIs when known; Retrieval+Call: retrieve and call a single API when unknown; Plan+Retrieval+Call: continuously plan, retrieve and call multiple APIs when unknown
